title: stelis cylindrica
intro: Stelis cylindrica, commonly known as the Orange Hill Orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is native to the Caribbean and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from inflammation, anxiety, and stress, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Stelis cylindrica include its antispasmodic, sedative, and vasodilatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Stelis cylindrica are responsible for its various health benefits and have been studied for their potential to treat various diseases and conditions, including hypertension, insomnia, and gastrointestinal disorders.
